latency_scope: Only required deployment computations. File I/O, logging I/O, dataset initialization, offline training/calibration, fault injection, GT/clean-reference evaluation, post-hoc metrics, memory-size bookkeeping, and archive creation are excluded from the latency intervals.
deployment_configuration: maximal final configuration: base/veto + Table-5 speed targeted branch + D-LLM/D-out consistency; its hook set subsumes the other final targets

synchronization_profiling.method: perf_counter placed around synchronization/device-to-host waits that already exist in the deployment path; no new detector-stage CUDA synchronization is added
synchronization_profiling.feature_extraction: sum of existing end-of-substage CUDA synchronization waits
synchronization_profiling.stage_hooks: device-to-host waits inside the 42 lean stage-summary hooks
synchronization_profiling.detector_execution: CPU-side sklearn/tree scoring after host feature materialization; requires no additional CUDA synchronization
